verdict.rationale: Veriff's API covers the core verification lifecycle (session creation, decision retrieval, webhooks, HMAC auth) per veriff-docs-6/7/3/10, but its own docs show manual review and case management are portal-only ('Verifications page in the Veriff Customer Portal', veriff-docs-12/13), and PDF export appears tied to the portal (veriff-docs-14), indicating UI-only functionality not mirrored in the API. No OpenAPI spec is discoverable (veriff-probe-2), limiting confidence that full API parity/documentation exists for programmatic exploration. Missing for 10: evidence of API endpoints for manual review/case management, PDF export via API, and a public OpenAPI spec confirming full endpoint coverage.
